requirement.original: 为什么style inspector不检查文件冗长度？很多command agent文件都有太多多余内容了
requirement.clarified: Enhance Standard 8 (Concise Documentation) to strictly enforce removal of non-functional content, repetitive examples, verbose explanations, pseudocode, and inline code blocks. All logic must be scriptified.
requirement.what: Strengthen Standard 8 detection logic in style-inspector to catch all forms of verbosity
requirement.why: Current Standard 8 only detects marketing language and >50 line examples, missing most verbosity issues

included: Add detection for inline code blocks (overlap with Standard 1)
Add specific grep patterns and LLM-based checks

success_criteria: Standard 8 detects non-functional descriptive text (stories not rules)
Standard 8 detects repetitive examples or explanations
Standard 8 detects pseudocode that should be real scripts
Standard 8 properly flags files that passed in previous clean run but have verbosity
Detection logic uses both grep patterns and LLM-based reading
Clear examples of violations vs acceptable content
constraints: Must preserve Standard 8's existing checks (marketing language, >50 line examples)
Must not overlap with Standard 1 (inline code) - clarify distinction
Must follow style-inspector budget protocol (5 files per round)

root_cause_analysis.symptom: style-inspector marked 'concise-documentation' as PASSED but user sees obvious verbosity in .claude files
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Standard 8 detection logic is too narrow - only checks for specific marketing phrases and >50 line example blocks
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 3d8c91a - Fix inspector agents: LLM-based hardcode detection + orphan script fixes
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Standard 8 was defined with simple grep patterns for obvious marketing language, but never enhanced to catch general verbosity
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Command and agent files accumulate verbose explanations, repetitive examples, pseudocode, and non-functional text that Standard 8 doesn't detect
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Standard 8 unchanged since at least 2026-01-11 (commit b5af07c), predates recent LLM-based detection improvements in Standard 2
